name: crashlytics-sourcemaps
description: Next.js app built with CRASHLYTICS_UPLOAD_MAPPING=true. Browser .js.map files are emitted during next build and stripped from the final container image by google.nodejs.websourcemaps; live Crashlytics upload requires a real Firebase app and is marked manual.

manualChecks.name: crashlytics-sourcemap-upload
manualChecks.description: Uploading browser .js.map files via firebase crashlytics:sourcemap:upload requires a live Firebase Web App ID (GOOGLE_CRASHLYTICS_APP_ID or FIREBASE_CRASHLYTICS_APP_ID) and GCP project credentials (GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT).
